description: AUTOPILOT project partners provide distinct sessions for platoon formation, cooperative driving and speed advice along the Helmond–Eindhoven corridor and Automotive Campus. Spatial coverage follows those test routes, used for evaluating connected-driving functions. Variants use live, average or no traffic-light information, different starting locations, application guidance, optional automatic speed actuation and rush-hour or other baselines. Some formation-only baselines have no automated platooning. Road descriptions span urban speed limits and the A270; the stated limits are test context, not verified current restrictions. Stream descriptions include CAN controls, object detections, GPS, route/speed advice, platoon events and service status. One GPS product is resampled at 100 milliseconds. Deposits with similar titles have different file descriptors and remain separately traceable; footage-related test labels do not justify reading media. No uniform success rate, safety benefit or exact observation interval is inferred. Zenodo provides the described files free under CC BY 4.0. Only descriptions and file descriptors were inspected; archives, values, code and media remain unread. File availability does not verify completeness, internal formats or measurement quality.
